about_short_description.short_description: BlueHill Payments is a payments technology company that manages complex billing.

product.name: Billing Automation
product.description: Automates invoicing and payment collection based on subscription plans to streamline billing processes.

product.name: Payment Orchestration
product.description: Routes payments automatically to optimal payment processors to manage transactions effectively.

product.name: Revenue Recovery System
product.description: Automates retrying failed payments and updates customers to recover lost revenue.

product.name: Subscription Management
product.description: Centralizes control of customer subscriptions, including plan management and renewals.

product.name: Customer Segmentation Tool
product.description: Segments customers based on subscription and payment data to enable targeted campaigns.

product.name: Invoice Management System
product.description: Creates, sends, and tracks invoices digitally to improve payment tracking and cash flow.
